## Description
TAAM Club is a premium restaurant brand in Istanbul, Turkey. The brand focuses on bold food experiences — signature burgers, crispy chicken, loaded fries, and artisanal desserts. Known for its editorial visual identity and strong Instagram presence with 12K+ followers.

## Cuisine & Menu
- Signature burgers (Ranch Tavuk Burger, TAAM Classic, Triple Tower)
- Crispy chicken
- Loaded fries (Fries Duo)
- Artisanal cookies and ice cream desserts
- Special drinks
Full menu: https://taamclub.com/menu
